SELECT r.id AS recipe_id, r.name, r.source_document_id, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.canonical_name, ri.raw_name) FROM recipe_ingredient ri LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = ri.ingredient_id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id AND (LOWER(i.canonical_name) = LOWER(#{filter.query}) OR LOWER(ri.raw_name) = LOWER(#{filter.query}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ingredient_alias ia WHERE ia.ingredient_id = ri.ingredient_id AND LOWER(ia.alias_name) = LOWER(#{filter.query})))) AS matched_ingredients FROM recipe r JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id WHERE ((s.source_type = 'SYSTEM_HOWTOCOOK' AND s.owner_user_id IS NULL AND s.visibility = 'PUBLIC') OR (s.source_type = 'USER_CUSTOM' AND s.visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND s.owner_user_id = #{filter.viewerUserId}))
AND r.category_code IN #{code}
AND (r.estimated_minutes <= #{filter.maxCookingMinutes} OR r.estimated_minutes IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipe_tool rt JOIN cooking_tool ct ON ct.id = rt.tool_id WHERE rt.recipe_id = r.id AND rt.optional = FALSE
AND LOWER(ct.canonical_name) NOT IN LOWER(#{tool})
AND TRUE )
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipe_ingredient ri LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = ri.ingredient_id WHERE ri.recipe_id = r.id AND (
LOWER(i.canonical_name) = LOWER(#{excluded}) OR LOWER(ri.raw_name) = LOWER(#{excluded}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ingredient_alias ia WHERE ia.ingredient_id = ri.ingredient_id AND LOWER(ia.alias_name) = LOWER(#{excluded})) ))
ORDER BY r.id
